title: Benchmark: environment badge in the app header
goal: Show a small badge in the caffeine-ux header on non-production builds naming the environment and the short build sha, so reviewers can tell a preview from production at a glance.
dod: non-production builds render a badge with the environment name and the 7-char build sha in the header
a component test covers both cases
constraints: Use the existing design-system components; no new dependencies.
demo_focus: open the preview app and screenshot the header badge showing the preview's sha
